about: The game links (docs/plan.md slice 33): the sites whose finished game or stream offers an app pump, in the order every screen lists them, each with the plain kind of contract/kinds.json the offer chooses (a game a match, a stream a stream). Each link's words are contract/copy/en.json's links.name.<key>, and its key rides the start link a watch takes (questpump://start?...&link=<key>) and the book's pump (contract/fixtures/backup.json's link). lichess holds the OAuth client id (free-form, no registration) and the redirect Lichess's sign-in returns to, whose scheme holds a dot (Lichess refuses a scheme without one); twitch holds the public client id of QuestPump's Twitch application, empty until it is registered, and while it is empty no page lists Twitch; contact is the address Chess.com's User-Agent names. Each phone asks each site from the device, never through a Pluxia server, and keeps the sign-in, the name or the key on the device alone. computer lists the games on the computer (docs/plan.md slice 35), in the order the desktop app's Games page listed them until slice 56 (its Games tab orders the tiles by their state, then by name): each key (letters only, never one of links: it is the link a match_end command carries), the name an offer and its match_end show, never translated and at most 40 characters (a picked program has none: the program's own), the systems it runs on (windows, macos) and how the desktop app hears it (gsi: Valve's Game State Integration; stats: Psyonix's Stats API; process: the game's process alone; since slice 48, docs/computer-games.md: client, a documented local API on the loopback the helper asks, StarCraft II's and Legends of Runeterra's; log, the game's own log or journal file read, MTG Arena's, Hearthstone's and Elite Dangerous's, since 2026-10-28 Mechabellum's and since 2026-10-29 Path of Exile's, Warframe's, Escape from Tarkov's, Deadlock's and Team Fortress 2's (these two with the player's launch option -condebug), Fortnite's, NARAKA: BLADEPOINT's, Fall Guys', Dead by Daylight's, Hunt: Showdown 1896's and VALORANT's; udp, the telemetry the game sends to a loopback port the player sets, F1's and Forza Motorsport's; shared, the game's documented telemetry in a read-only shared-memory view opened and closed at each look, never a handle to its process, iRacing's, Assetto Corsa Competizione's and since 2026-10-28 Assetto Corsa's and Guild Wars 2's MumbleLink, since 2026-10-29 Automobilista 2's (with its Shared Memory set to Project CARS 2); files, since 2026-10-28, a new file in the game's own save folder noticed by its time alone, never opened, Slay the Spire 2's run history, and since 2026-10-29 World of Warships' replays folder (its battle file there or gone, a new replay) and Rainbow Six Siege's match replays (a new match folder, its round files' times), PUBG's replays (a new match folder, its end file there), and the files Halo: The Master Chief Collection, Brawlhalla, rFactor 2, Le Mans Ultimate, osu!, Stardew Valley and Warcraft III save at an end (a newer one's time); screen, since 2026-10-29, the middle of the game's own window captured about four times a second while it runs on Windows and read for a boss's banner, no frame or word kept, ELDEN RING's and ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN's), and aim, present and true alone, for a game whose matches load the hands and arms (a shooter: slice 48's arms rest, which leaves the arm moves out of a pump started while the game still runs; never on program or a process game, which has closed when its pump starts), checkpoint, present and true alone (2026-10-28), for a game whose feed tells a mission handed in rather than a match's end (Elite Dangerous; since 2026-10-29 Path of Exile's map left, Warframe's mission ended, osu!'s play passed and Stardew Valley's day slept through; ELDEN RING's and ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN's boss felled), whose finish waits match_checkpoint_min from the game's start or the last that offered, never on program or a process game; the Games tab's words for each are links.name.<key>, and the helper builds the list in (questpump-core games.rs). Both phones bundle the file (they read links and leave computer to the match_end command), and tools/copytext.py --check fails on a key other than lower-case letters or named twice, a kind contract/kinds.json lacks, a link without its words or words for no link, an empty or missing contact, Lichess client id or redirect, a redirect scheme without a dot, a missing twitch block, a contract/kinds.json without the stream kind, and in computer a key other than lower-case letters, named twice or also a link of links, a name missing, empty or over 40 characters (or one for program, which has none), no program entry, a system other than windows or macos, a trigger other than gsi, stats, process, client, log, udp, shared, files or screen, an aim or a checkpoint other than true or on program or a process game, a computer game other than program without its words (links.name.<key>), and a contract/kinds.json without the match kind its ends offer.

computer.name: Path of Exile or Path of Exile 2
